concepts.learning_objective: State the origin of the word 'poetry' and what it says about the poet and the poem.
Identify the characteristic features of poetry such as rhythm, metre and figures of speech.

topics.title: The peacock's sudden appearance and colours

concepts.learning_objective: Interpret the colour images used to describe the peacock's neck and tail.
Explain how the poem shows the peacock as a bird glimpsed only briefly.

topics.title: Reading in the veranda: signs of the peacock

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the changes in the surroundings that signal the peacock is near.
Analyse the link the poem makes between deep absorption in a book and seeing the peacock.

topics.title: The tail that blinks: closing image, poet and vocabulary

concepts.learning_objective: Evaluate the closing image of the tail that blinks for eyes that are always open.
State facts about Sujata Bhatt and infer word meanings such as 'turquoise' and 'darts'.
